document.page_text:
RECA M3 Synthetic Evidence Study
Title: AI Use and Learning Engagement in Undergraduate Students
Year: 2025
Research object: undergraduate students at one teaching university
Sample: 312 undergraduate students completed the survey.
Core variables: weekly generative AI use and learning engagement.
Research design: cross-sectional observational study.
Analysis method: multiple linear regression adjusted for study year.
Main conclusion: Higher reported generative AI use was associated with higher learning engagement; the study did not establish causality.
Limitation: Single-campus self-report data and the cross-sectional design limit generalizability and causal inference.
This is a synthetic acceptance fixture, not a real publication.
